knowledge.name: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇
knowledge.explanation: painting, sculpture, gallery, artist, masterpiece 是谈论艺术的基本词。

knowledge.name: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历
knowledge.explanation: have/has + 过去分词表示经历，常与 ever, never, twice 连用。

knowledge.name: Art and artists 被动语态说作品
knowledge.explanation: was/were + 过去分词说明作品由谁创作、何时完成。

knowledge.name: Art and artists 描述与评价
knowledge.explanation: 评价常用 It is considered …、in my view、impressive 等表达。

knowledge.name: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇
knowledge.explanation: invent 指发明（创造新事物），discover 指发现（原已存在的事物）。

knowledge.name: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动
knowledge.explanation: was/were + 过去分词，说明发明时间与发明者。

knowledge.name: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句
knowledge.explanation: who 指人，which/that 指物，从句紧跟先行词。

knowledge.name: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响
knowledge.explanation: 常用 It has changed …、It makes our lives easier 评价发明。

knowledge.name: Money 金钱相关词汇
knowledge.explanation: pocket money, save, spend, budget, afford 是理财话题核心词。

knowledge.name: Money 情态动词给建议
knowledge.explanation: should、ought to、had better + 动词原形表达建议或规劝。

knowledge.name: Money 条件句表达计划
knowledge.explanation: If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

knowledge.name: Money 消费观点表达
knowledge.explanation: 表达观点用 I think …、In my opinion …，并给出理由。

knowledge.name: Fashion 服装与风格词汇
knowledge.explanation: outfit, stylish, fashionable, try on, match 是时尚话题常用词。

knowledge.name: Fashion 描述现在的穿着
knowledge.explanation: wear 表状态，be wearing 表现在进行；fit 指合身。

knowledge.name: Fashion 比较级与最高级评价
knowledge.explanation: 用 -er/-est 或 more/most 比较款式与价格。

knowledge.name: Fashion 表达观点与建议
knowledge.explanation: 评价衣着宜用 I think …、It suits you 等礼貌表达。

knowledge.name: Natural disasters 灾害词汇
knowledge.explanation: flood, earthquake, typhoon, drought, landslide 是常见灾害词。

knowledge.name: Natural disasters 过去进行时描述场景
knowledge.explanation: was/were + doing 表示过去某一时刻正在发生。

knowledge.name: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害
knowledge.explanation: 灾害报道常用被动：were destroyed, was hit。

knowledge.name: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议
knowledge.explanation: should/must + 动词原形表达必要的防护措施。

knowledge.name: Friendship 友谊词汇与搭配
knowledge.explanation: trust, support, share, get along with 是友谊话题核心表达。

knowledge.name: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友
knowledge.explanation: 用 who/that 引导定语从句补充说明朋友的品质。

knowledge.name: Friendship 安慰与建议
knowledge.explanation: 安慰用 I'm sorry to hear that；建议用 Why not …? / You'd better …。

knowledge.name: Friendship 写一段关于友谊的文字
knowledge.explanation: 写友谊短文要有具体事例、真情实感和清楚结构。

chapters.name: Unit 1 Art and artists
chapters.summary: 谈论艺术门类、艺术家与作品评价。

questions.stem: A person who makes paintings is a（ ）。
questions.analysis: painter 指画家。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇

questions.stem: You can see many works of art in a（ ）。
questions.analysis: gallery 是美术馆、画廊。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇

questions.stem: Fill in: This painting is a famous ___（杰作）.
questions.analysis: masterpiece 意为杰作。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇

questions.stem: A sculpture is usually made of stone, wood or metal.
questions.analysis: 雕塑多以石、木、金属制成。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇

questions.stem: Write two sentences about a kind of art you like.

answer.value: 示例：I like Chinese ink paintings. They use only black ink but show a whole world.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句话、用词正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 艺术门类与人物词汇

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时为 have + 过去分词 seen。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历
options: I have seen that painting twice.
I have saw that painting twice.

questions.stem: —Have you ever been to an art museum? —___
questions.analysis: Have 提问用 have 回答。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历

questions.stem: Fill in: She has ___（draw）three pictures this week.
questions.analysis: draw 的过去分词是 drawn。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历

questions.stem: 「I have finished it yesterday」 is correct.
questions.analysis: yesterday 是明确过去时间，应用一般过去时。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历

questions.stem: Write two sentences about art experiences using「have/has …」.

answer.value: 示例：I have visited the city gallery. My sister has learned to paint for three years.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句话均为现在完成时。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 现在完成时谈经历

questions.stem: This picture ___ by a young artist in 1998.
questions.analysis: 画作是被画的，用被动语态 was painted。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 被动语态说作品

questions.stem: The sculptures ___ of stone.
questions.analysis: 雕塑是被制成的，用 are made。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 被动语态说作品

questions.stem: Fill in: The song ___（write）by a famous musician.
questions.analysis: write 的被动语态为 was written。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 被动语态说作品

questions.stem: In a passive sentence, the doer can be left out with「by」.
questions.analysis: by 短语用来引出执行者，省略 by 时不表示执行者。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 被动语态说作品

questions.stem: Rewrite with the passive: Someone built this gallery in 1950.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：改为被动且保留时间。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 被动语态说作品

questions.stem: Choose the best sentence to give an opinion.
questions.analysis: In my view 后接完整句子。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 描述与评价
options: In my view, this painting is powerful.

questions.stem: The word closest in meaning to「very impressive」is（ ）。
questions.analysis: striking 意为引人注目的。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 描述与评价

questions.stem: Fill in: The colours in this work are so ___（vivid）that they catch your eye.
questions.analysis: vivid 意为鲜艳的。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 描述与评价

questions.stem: 「It is considered a masterpiece」 means people think it is a masterpiece.
questions.analysis: be considered 表示被认为。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 描述与评价

questions.stem: Describe one work of art you have seen in 3 sentences.

answer.value: 示例：I once saw a huge ink painting of mountains. The ink shades were simple but full of power. It made me feel quiet inside.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三句连贯、有评价。
questions.knowledge_point: Art and artists 描述与评价

chapters.name: Unit 2 Great inventions and discoveries
chapters.summary: 谈论发明发现及其意义。

questions.stem: Which word means「发明」?
questions.analysis: invent 是发明。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇

questions.stem: Columbus ___ America, but he did not ___ the compass.
questions.analysis: 发现新大陆用 discover，发明指南针用 invent。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇

questions.stem: Fill in: The telephone was a great ___（发明）.
questions.analysis: invention 是名词「发明」。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇

questions.stem: A discovery is something that already exists but is found.
questions.analysis: 发现的对象原本就存在。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇

questions.stem: Write two sentences: one invention you use and one discovery you know.

answer.value: 示例：I use the mobile phone every day. Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：invention 与 discovery 用法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 发明与发现词汇

questions.stem: The telephone ___ by Alexander Graham Bell.
questions.analysis: 单数主语 + was invented。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动

questions.stem: Paper ___ in China long ago.
questions.analysis: 纸是被造的，过去时被动。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动

questions.stem: Fill in: The first computer ___（build）in the 1940s.
questions.analysis: build 的过去时被动为 was built。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动

questions.stem: 「The wheel was invented thousands of years ago」 is correct.
questions.analysis: 过去时被动，时态与语态都正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动

questions.stem: Write a passive sentence about when a common invention was made.

answer.value: 示例：The electric light was invented by Edison in 1879.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：被动语态 + 时间或发明者。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 过去时被动

questions.stem: The man ___ invented the telephone was a teacher.
questions.analysis: 先行词是人，用 who。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句

questions.stem: This is the machine ___ changed our lives.
questions.analysis: 先行词是物，用 that/which。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句

questions.stem: Fill in: I know a scientist ___ studies new materials.（填关系代词）
questions.analysis: 先行词是人，用 who。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句

questions.stem: In「the book which I bought」,「which」refers to the book.
questions.analysis: which 指代先行词 the book。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句

questions.stem: Combine into one sentence: I met a girl. She designed a robot.

answer.value: I met a girl who designed a robot.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 who 合并、语序正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 定语从句

questions.stem: Which sentence best describes the effect of an invention?
questions.analysis: 「It has changed the way we …」表达影响。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响
options: It has changed the way we travel.

questions.stem: The word「convenient」means（ ）。
questions.analysis: convenient 意为便利的。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响

questions.stem: Fill in: The Internet makes information ___（easy）to get.
questions.analysis: 比较级 easier 表示更容易。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响

questions.stem: Inventions can also bring problems such as pollution.
questions.analysis: 发明也可能带来环境问题。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响

questions.stem: Write 3 sentences about one invention's good and bad effects.

answer.value: 示例：The car makes travel fast and comfortable. But it has caused air pollution. We should use it wisely.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：好处 + 坏处 + 态度。
questions.knowledge_point: Great inventions and discoveries 谈意义与影响

chapters.name: Unit 3 Money
chapters.summary: 谈论零花钱、理财与消费选择。

questions.stem: To keep money for later use is to（ ）。
questions.analysis: save 表示储蓄。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 金钱相关词汇

questions.stem: If you cannot ___ a new bike, you may wait.
questions.analysis: afford 表示买得起。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 金钱相关词汇

questions.stem: Fill in: My parents give me 50 yuan as ___（零用钱）every month.
questions.analysis: pocket money 是零花钱。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 金钱相关词汇

questions.stem: A budget helps you plan how to use your money.
questions.analysis: 预算是用钱计划。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 金钱相关词汇

questions.stem: Write two sentences about how you use your pocket money.

answer.value: 示例：I save half of my pocket money every month. I spend the rest on books and pens.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句都用对动词搭配。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 金钱相关词汇

questions.stem: You ___ save some money for a rainy day.
questions.analysis: should 后接动词原形。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 情态动词给建议

questions.stem: You had better ___ before you buy something expensive.
questions.analysis: had better 后接动词原形。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 情态动词给建议

questions.stem: Fill in: We ___ to respect our parents' money.（填情态动词）
questions.analysis: ought to 表示应当。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 情态动词给建议

questions.stem: 「You should to save money」 is correct.
questions.analysis: should 后不加 to。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 情态动词给建议

questions.stem: Write two pieces of advice on saving money.

answer.value: 示例：You should make a spending plan. You had better not buy things you don't need.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两条建议、结构正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 情态动词给建议

questions.stem: If I save 20 yuan a week, I ___ a new book in a month.
questions.analysis: 条件句主将从现：will buy。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 条件句表达计划

questions.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.analysis: 从句用一般现在时 rains。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 条件句表达计划

questions.stem: Fill in: If you ___（need）help, ask your parents.
questions.analysis: 从句用一般现在时。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 条件句表达计划

questions.stem: 「If I will have money, I will help you」 is correct.
questions.analysis: 从句不用 will，应为 If I have money。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 条件句表达计划

questions.stem: Write one if-sentence about your saving plan.

answer.value: 示例：If I save 10 yuan every week, I will buy a gift for my mother in May.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：从句现、主句将来。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 条件句表达计划

questions.stem: Which sentence gives a reason?
questions.analysis: because 引出理由。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 消费观点表达
options: I think it is worth buying because it will last long.

questions.stem: 「worth」 in「It is worth the money」 means（ ）。
questions.analysis: worth 意为值得。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 消费观点表达

questions.stem: Fill in: In my ___（看法）, we should not waste money.
questions.analysis: In my opinion 是常见表达。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 消费观点表达

questions.stem: A good argument usually includes a reason or an example.
questions.analysis: 理由与例子支撑观点。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 消费观点表达

questions.stem: Do you think students should get pocket money? Give one reason.

answer.value: 示例：Yes, I think they should, because it teaches them how to plan and save.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：明确立场 + 一个理由。
questions.knowledge_point: Money 消费观点表达

chapters.name: Unit 4 Fashion
chapters.summary: 谈论服装、风格与购物选择。

questions.stem: To put on clothes in a shop to see if they fit is to（ ）。
questions.analysis: try on 表示试穿。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 服装与风格词汇

questions.stem: Which word means「时髦的」?
questions.analysis: fashionable 意为时髦的。

questions.stem: Fill in: These shoes ___（搭配）your dress well.

questions.stem: An outfit means the clothes worn together at one time.

questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 服装与风格词汇

questions.stem: Describe what you usually wear at weekends in two sentences.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句、含服装词。

questions.stem: Look! She ___ a red dress today.

questions.stem: This coat ___ me well, so I will take it.

questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 描述现在的穿着

questions.stem: Fill in: The trousers are too long. They don't ___（合身）me.
questions.analysis: 此处理想用 fit。

questions.stem: 「He is wearing a hat」 describes his clothes at this moment.
questions.analysis: 现在进行时描述此刻穿着。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 描述现在的穿着

questions.stem: Describe a friend's clothes today in two sentences.

answer.value: 示例：Lily is wearing a white shirt and a blue skirt. The colours match each other well.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句、时态正确。

questions.stem: This shirt is ___ than that one.
questions.analysis: 比较级 cheaper。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 比较级与最高级评价

questions.stem: It is the ___ popular style this year.

questions.stem: Fill in: These shoes are ___（comfortable）than those boots.

questions.stem: 「the most cheap」 is correct English.

questions.stem: Compare two pieces of clothing you own.

answer.value: 示例：My sports shoes are cheaper than my boots, but the boots are warmer in winter.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两处比较级用法正确。

questions.stem: Which sentence gives advice about buying clothes?

questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 表达观点与建议
options: You should choose clothes that fit you.

questions.stem: Fill in: That colour ___（适合）you.
questions.analysis: suit 表示适合（衣服、颜色）。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 表达观点与建议

questions.stem: Being comfortable is more important than following fashion for students.
questions.analysis: 对学生而言舒适更重要。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 表达观点与建议

questions.stem: Give a friend advice on buying a school bag (two sentences).

answer.value: 示例：You should choose a light bag with wide straps. It will be better for your shoulders.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两条建议、语法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Fashion 表达观点与建议

chapters.name: Unit 5 Natural disasters

questions.stem: A long period with no rain causes a（ ）。

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 灾害词汇

questions.stem: Which one is a disaster that shakes the ground?

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 灾害词汇

questions.stem: Fill in: Heavy rain may cause a ___（洪水）in the low land.

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 灾害词汇

questions.stem: A typhoon usually brings strong wind and heavy rain.

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 灾害词汇

questions.stem: Name two natural disasters that may happen in your area.

answer.value: 示例：Typhoons in summer and floods after heavy rain.

questions.stem: When the earthquake happened, we ___ dinner.

questions.stem: While it ___ hard, the lights went out.

questions.stem: Fill in: They ___（sleep）when the phone rang.
questions.analysis: 过去进行时 were sleeping。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 过去进行时描述场景

questions.stem: Past continuous describes an action happening at a certain past moment.

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 过去进行时描述场景

questions.stem: Write one sentence with past continuous about a storm.

answer.value: 示例：The wind was blowing hard while we were closing the windows.

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 过去进行时描述场景

questions.stem: Many houses ___ by the flood last year.
questions.analysis: 复数主语 + were destroyed。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害

questions.stem: The city ___ by a strong typhoon.
questions.analysis: 单数主语 + was hit。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害

questions.stem: Fill in: Two bridges ___（damage）in the earthquake.
questions.analysis: 被动语态 were damaged。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害

questions.stem: In news reports about disasters, the passive voice is often used when the doer is unknown.
questions.analysis: 执行者不明时常用被动。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害

questions.stem: Write a passive sentence about what happened in a disaster.

answer.value: 示例：Thousands of trees were pulled down by the strong wind.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：被动语态、时态正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 被动语态报道灾害

questions.stem: During an earthquake, you ___ stay under a strong desk.
questions.analysis: should 后接动词原形。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议

questions.stem: You ___ run outside during a typhoon.

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议

questions.stem: Which are safe actions during an earthquake?

questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议
options: Keep calm and listen to teachers

questions.stem: It is dangerous to use the lift when a fire breaks out.
questions.analysis: 火灾时电梯可能断电。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议

questions.stem: Write two safety rules for a typhoon day.

answer.value: 示例：You should stay indoors and close the windows. You must not go near the sea.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两条规则、情态动词正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Natural disasters 安全防护与建议

chapters.name: Unit 6 Friendship
chapters.summary: 谈论友谊、描述朋友与给出建议。

questions.stem: A good friend is someone you can（ ）。

questions.stem: Fill in: A true friend will ___（支持）you when you are in trouble.
questions.analysis: support 意为支持。

questions.stem: Sharing problems with a friend can make you feel better.
questions.analysis: 分享能减轻压力。

questions.stem: Write two sentences about what makes a good friend.

answer.value: 示例：A good friend is honest with you. He is also ready to help when you need him.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句、观点清楚。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 友谊词汇与搭配

questions.stem: I have a friend ___ always helps me with maths.
questions.analysis: 先行词是人，用 who。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友

questions.stem: She is the girl ___ we met at the party.
questions.analysis: 先行词是人，可用 that/who。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友

questions.stem: Fill in: This is the friend ___（我）trust most.（用关系代词，指人）
questions.analysis: 指人用 who。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友

questions.stem: 「The friend which helped me」 is correct.
questions.analysis: 指人应用 who/that。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友

questions.stem: Combine: I have a classmate. He is good at drawing.

answer.value: I have a classmate who is good at drawing.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 who 合并、句意完整。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 定语从句描述朋友

questions.stem: Your friend failed a test. Which is the best reply?
questions.analysis: 先安慰再提出帮助最合适。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 安慰与建议
options: I'm sorry to hear that. Let's work on it together.

questions.stem: 「Why not talk to your teacher?」 is used to（ ）。
questions.analysis: Why not …? 用于给建议。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 安慰与建议

questions.stem: Fill in: You'd better ___（tell）your parents about it.
questions.analysis: had better 后接动词原形。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 安慰与建议

questions.stem: Listening carefully is important when a friend talks about problems.
questions.analysis: 倾听本身就是支持。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 安慰与建议

questions.stem: Write a short reply to comfort a friend who moved to a new school.

answer.value: 示例：I'm sorry you feel lonely there. Why not join a club? You will make new friends soon.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：安慰 + 建议各一句。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 安慰与建议

questions.stem: A good paragraph about friendship should include（ ）。
questions.analysis: 主题句 + 事例是基本结构。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 写一段关于友谊的文字
options: a clear topic sentence and an example

questions.stem: Which sentence is a good topic sentence?
questions.analysis: 第一句点明主题并有观点。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 写一段关于友谊的文字
options: My best friend has taught me what trust means.

questions.stem: Fill in: We have been friends ___（for/since）five years.
questions.analysis: for + 时间段。
questions.knowledge_point: Friendship 写一段关于友谊的文字

questions.stem: A story about a small help can show friendship better than big words.
questions.analysis: 具体小事更有说服力。

questions.stem: Write 3 sentences about a friend who helped you.

answer.value: 示例：Last term I was ill for a week. My friend Lily sent me her notes every day. Her help made me feel I was not alone.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三句连贯、有事例。
